acceptance.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.content: By accessing and using Streamlyra, you agree to be bound by these Terms and Conditions and all applicable laws and regulations.

openSource.title: 2. Open Source Software
openSource.content: Streamlyra is an open-source project distributed under the MIT license. The software is provided 'as is', without warranty of any kind.

disclaimer.title: 3. Platform Disclaimer
disclaimer.content: Streamlyra is NOT affiliated, associated, authorized, endorsed by, or in any way officially connected with TikTok, Twitch, YouTube, Kick or any of their subsidiaries or affiliates.

tiktok.title: 4. TikTok Usage (Unofficial)
tiktok.content: Streamlyra uses unofficial methods to interact with TikTok services. Use of unofficial third-party tools may violate TikTok's Terms of Service. By using this integration, you acknowledge that you do so at your own risk.

data.title: 1. Data Processing
data.content: Streamlyra prioritizes your privacy. Data processing is mainly done locally or through direct connections with the corresponding platform APIs.

storage.title: 2. Local Storage
storage.content: We use your browser's local storage (localStorage) to keep your session active and remember your preferences. We do not use third-party tracking cookies.

noSharing.title: 3. No Information Sharing
noSharing.content: We do not sell, rent, or share your personal information with third parties. As an open-source project, you can audit our code to verify how we handle your data.
